title: Graph-dependent shrinkage priors for Bayesian trend filtering
abstract: arXiv:2608.23802v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many common data dependencies can be characterized by graphs: time series data are sequential (chain graph), images appear as pixels (lattice graph), areal data are defined by neighboring units (spatial adjacency graph), etc. Graph trend filtering seeks to smooth and predict such data. However, classical trend filtering only incorporates the graph for estimation of the trend, which limits its adaptivity, and is brittle in the presence of missing data. Further, it lacks uncertainty quantification and faces certain computing challenges. We address these limitations with a comprehensive Bayesian framework for (graph-) dependent data. Our approach leverages the graph at three critical junctures: 1) the trend, to enable smoothing, imputation, and prediction; 2) the local shrinkage, to enhance adaptivity and precision; and 3) the MCMC sampling algorithm, to deliver scalable posterior (predictive) inference via sparse and banded operations. F

translated_title: 基于图的收缩先验用于贝叶斯趋势滤波
translated_abstract: 许多常见的数据依赖关系可以通过图来表征：时间序列数据是顺序的（链图），图像表现为像素（格点图），区域数据由相邻单元定义（空间邻接图）等。图趋势滤波旨在平滑和预测此类数据。然而，经典趋势滤波仅将图用于趋势估计，这限制了其适应性，并且在存在缺失数据时显得脆弱。此外，它缺乏不确定性量化，并面临某些计算挑战。我们通过一个全面的贝叶斯框架来解决这些限制，适用于（图）依赖数据。我们的方法在三个关键节点利用图：1）趋势，以实现平滑、插补和预测；2）局部收缩，以增强适应性和精度；以及3）MCMC采样算法，通过稀疏和带状操作提供可扩展的后验（预测）推断。
tldr: 本文提出了一种全面贝叶斯趋势滤波框架，通过在图趋势、局部收缩和MCMC采样三个层面利用图结构，解决了经典方法在适应性、缺失数据处理、不确定性和计算效率上的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a comprehensive Bayesian trend filtering framework that leverages graph structure at three levels—trend, local shrinkage, and MCMC sampling—to address limitations in adaptivity, missing data handling, uncertainty quantification, and computational efficiency.
